Archiving hides a credential from future selection and retains its files and history. Maximum 8 MiB per file and 128 MiB total reserved storage per account, including incomplete uploads and archived revisions.

procurement.portal.offer.locked: Attempted fields are locked for an identical, idempotent retry.
procurement.portal.detail.buyerHint: This company published the requirements and will receive supplier proposals.

procurement.portal.detail.reviewHint: Check quantities, specifications and whether you can meet the published scope.

procurement.portal.detail.submitHint: Sign in with a confirmed email, complete your proposal and track it in My submissions. Submission does not guarantee an award.
procurement.portal.detail.openHint: Open participation: a confirmed account can submit without prior supplier registration. Representing an existing supplier requires authorization.
procurement.portal.detail.invitationHint: Invitation only: viewing this page does not grant eligibility. You need an invitation and authorization to represent the supplier.
procurement.portal.detail.approvedHint: Approved suppliers only: you need an eligible supplier relationship and authorization to represent that supplier.
procurement.portal.detail.openingQuestio: When can the buyer open proposals?
procurement.portal.detail.receiptHint: The buyer can open proposals as they arrive; they do not need to wait for participation to close.
procurement.portal.detail.openingHint: The buyer can open proposals only once participation has closed and the published opening time has arrived.
procurement.portal.detail.requirementsHi: Use these published quantities and specifications as the basis for your quotation.
procurement.portal.detail.finalHint: You will prepare the proposal in your account. Review it carefully: submitted quotations cannot be edited.
